Class ParallelBus

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.api.io.ParallelBus
public final class ParallelBus extends Object
An 8-bit parallel output bus, as display shields wire it: eight data pins written together, latched by a write strobe pulsed low then high. Recognized as compiler intrinsics by Juno: the runtime resolves each pin to its GPIO port once in begin(int[], int), so a byte costs a few port register writes instead of one Gpio.digitalWrite(int, boolean) per changed pin and two per strobe.

There is one bus. Its pins must already be outputs (Gpio.pinMode(int, int)); the bus drives every data pin on each write, so their levels may be changed in between (to share them with a touch panel, say).
